title: Drivings
description: Published driving guides, source-backed UK and US test-centre search, and study-plan previews.
summary: Published driving guides, source-backed UK and US test-centre search, and study-plan previews.
offersHint: Published driving guides, source-backed UK and US test-centre search, and study-plan previews. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.drivings.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_driving_guides
toolsPreview.description: Search published Drivings guides by topic or question. Returns concise metadata, update dates and canonical URLs; it does not access private learner data.

toolsPreview.name: get_driving_guide
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve one published Drivings guide by slug, including bounded Markdown content, update metadata and primary-source review details when available. It does not access private learner data.

toolsPreview.name: list_study_options
toolsPreview.description: List the study courses Drivings publishes for the UK or US. Returns canonical pages and a confirmation-required onboarding browser handoff; it does not start or save onboarding.

toolsPreview.name: find_test_centres
toolsPreview.description: Search the source-backed UK or US test-centre directory by name, locality, address, postcode/ZIP, alias or identifier. Returns evidence and optional confirmation-required official browser handoffs. Never books or changes a test.

toolsPreview.name: build_study_plan_preview
toolsPreview.description: Compute a deterministic, bounded study schedule. The preview is not saved and does not create an account, learner session, purchase or message.

toolsPreview.name: get_my_learning_overview
toolsPreview.description: Read the connected learner's Drivings profile, study target and recent learning activity. Requires Drivings sign-in and explicit OAuth consent. It never changes learner or account data.
